newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's BBA denies acquisition of BCN.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's BBA denies acquisition of BCN.

text.p: Brazilian private bank Banco BBA Creditanstalt denied on Thursday it has agreed to acquire local private bank BCN, a bank spokeswoman said.
Newspapers today reported BBA would take over BCN under a deal worth between $300 million and $500 million. According to news reports, the deal would be announced in coming days.
Trade in BCN stock was suspended today on the Sao Paulo Stock Exchange (Bovespa) following the reports, the bourse said.
Although both banks had repeatedly denied any deal, in recent months BCN and BBA have been the subject of speculation in the press that a merger or a takeover would be announced any time soon.
Austria's Creditanstalt-Bankverein owns 49 percent of Brazil's Banco BBA Creditanstalt.
Earlier this year BCN merged with local bank Banco Itamarati.
